comments.author: Snipe
comments.body:
Given to every player who enrolls in the school for the first time......considerby the rarest equipment in the game. (Of course one can always create a new character, lvl it to lvl 10 then exchange it.) Requires Student title.

After the introduction of layering tools, it is theoretically possible for this item to be layered till the end of time, even when one loses the title. (I haven't tried this out yet, it is based on the mechanics of the layering tools.)

Have the character equip the student title, then layer this on (with the hat, if you wish). Even if the character finishes school, thus losing the title, the layered equipment should still stay on.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: This is sold in the Portuguese town of Sagres for 1,000 ducats. Of course... we won't get Sagres until Order of the Prince expansion, following the conclusion of Age of Revolution.
